# Restoricon, LLC

> Restoricon, LLC is a Connecticut general contractor providing residential remodeling and construction services to homeowners across Hartford County and the surrounding area. The company is self-described as a licensed General Contractor (CT HIC).

Restoricon offers full home remodeling and additions, kitchen and bathroom renovations, interior and exterior finishes, structural repairs and framing, project management and Connecticut permitting assistance, and a free Pre-Claim Construction & Repair Estimate service (a builder-led damage assessment for storm, water, fire, or impact damage — not public adjusting or insurance claim negotiation).

Homeowners can request a consultation or estimate by phone at (860) 470-6773, by email at restoricon@gmail.com, or via the contact form on the website. Restoricon also recruits vetted 1099 subcontractors (licensed, insured trades) through a Trade Partners application process.

The website is a single page (https://restoricon.com/) with in-page sections reachable by anchor link.

## Pages

- [Restoricon, LLC](https://restoricon.com/): Full site — services, about, FAQ, subcontractor recruitment, homeowner contract template, and contact form. Key sections: `#services`, `#about`, `#faq`, `#subcontractors`, `#homeowner-contract`, `#contact`.

## Documents

- [Homeowner Home Improvement Contract Template](https://restoricon.com/assets/documents/Restoricon_Home_Improvement_Contract.docx): Standard residential contract template prepared in accordance with the Connecticut Home Improvement Act.
- [Subcontractor Master Services Agreement Template](https://restoricon.com/assets/documents/Subcontractor_MSA.docx): Standard subcontractor onboarding agreement terms.

## Notes

- Restoricon does not publish a public street address (service-area business model); service area is described generally as Connecticut / Hartford County.
- Restoricon is not a Public Adjuster and does not negotiate insurance claims or waive insurance deductibles.
